about: Renders a list of rows a person selects from, with the keyboard interaction of the ARIA listbox pattern.

columns.about: Tiles in four columns. A grid collection moves the highlight with all four arrow keys. The collection and the recipe take the same column count, because the keys move by the collection's count and the recipe places the tiles by its own.
columns.title: A grid of tiles

described.about: A description under each row's text. The mark at the end centres on the row's height.
described.title: Descriptions

effect.about: A glow around the selected row, in the palette's solid.
effect.title: Effects

grouped.about: Rows under group labels. A screen reader announces the group as the highlight enters it, and the arrow keys skip the labels.
grouped.title: Grouped

highlight.about: Every highlight, on Lantern, beside the selected Fathom. The arrow keys move the highlight.
highlight.title: Highlights

kinds.about: An icon before each row's text, set by `icon`. The icon names the kind of client.
kinds.title: Icons

locked.about: A disabled row. It renders and a screen reader reads it, so a person learns the option exists. The arrow keys skip it and a press does nothing.
locked.title: A disabled row

many.about: Ten thousand rows, of which about twenty are in the document. Hold an arrow key: the list scrolls to each row before it renders, and the scrollbar matches the whole list.
many.title: Ten thousand rows

modes.about: One row, several rows, or several rows the way a file manager selects them. In extended mode a press replaces the selection and a modifier key adds to it. The lists that allow several rows render a checkbox on every row.
modes.title: Selection modes

narrowing.about: A field above the rows filters them as a person types. The arrow keys move the highlight and Enter selects a row without leaving the field. Type text that matches no client to show the empty text.
narrowing.title: Filtering

orientation.about: Rows down a column, and along a row with the left and right arrow keys. In a horizontal list a row takes the width of its text, and the list scrolls sideways.
orientation.title: Down and across

outside.about: The selection is held in the caller's state, which two buttons also write. The list follows the state.
outside.title: Controlled selection

palette.about: Every palette, with a solid fill on the selected row. The palette sets the fill, the highlight and the checkboxes.
palette.title: Palettes

selected.about: Every fill of a selected row. `plain` relies on the mark at the row's end and a medium weight.
selected.title: Selected rows

title: Listbox

triggered.about: The list inside a popover. A select is the better control unless the rows need this much room.
triggered.title: In a popover

whole.about: A select-all row above the rows, and a summary of the selection below them. The row selects every row, and clears the selection when every row is selected. While part of the list is selected its checkbox shows the mixed mark.
whole.title: Select all
